title: Artifact Surface Foundation candidate drift audit

findings.condition: No canonical Artifact Type registry currently resolves admitted type versions and decision overlays.
findings.remediation: Review the candidate Artifact Type Registry contract and initial 25-entry postimage; do not materialize it as current before admission.

findings.condition: A new artifact kind that fits no admitted type has no typed fail-closed intake path.
findings.remediation: Use Artifact Type Request only as candidate intake; never consume it as the proposed subject artifact.

findings.condition: Nested package facets and independent nested package homes are not machine-declared.
findings.remediation: Require lifecycle owner, unit of change, carrier classification, and explicit nested-package relations before migration.

findings.condition: Capability Instance/v1 does not require canonical package-home bindings.
findings.remediation: Preserve v1 and author a separately tested successor after the Artifact Surface Foundation is approved.

claim_ceiling: Candidate drift evidence only. It does not change the live Definition registry, establish Artifact Type conformance, or authorize package migration.
